tools.name: match_embeddings
tools.description: Match caller-supplied vectors in a named embedding space; unique cosine winners are best guesses, ties remain ambiguous, and no model is loaded

tools.name: render_markdown
tools.description: Render exact Markdown source to HTML with a source-retaining receipt, dialect, and explicit extension profile; preserves raw HTML/URI schemes except selected GFM tag filtering and is not a sanitizer

tools.name: inspect_markdown
tools.description: Index exact Markdown block ranges, source line maps, nested containers, and sections

tools.name: markdown_context
tools.description: Extract exact block-aligned Markdown context and enclosing sections

tools.name: plan_markdown_list_item
tools.description: Insert, replace, or remove a root or nested Markdown list item with structural validation and exact source identity

tools.name: plan_markdown_section
tools.description: Plan a structurally validated Markdown section body replacement selected by root heading index or nested path

tools.name: plan_markdown_reference
tools.description: Plan replacement of a selected Markdown reference definition's decoded destination and title

tools.name: plan_markdown_table_column
tools.description: Plan a nested GFM column insertion, removal, or alignment change with structural validation

tools.name: plan_markdown_table_row
tools.description: Plan insertion or removal of a GFM body row by nested table path and zero-based body index

tools.name: plan_markdown_table_cell
tools.description: Plan a source-preserving GFM cell edit by nested block path; row zero is the header

tools.name: plan_markdown_task
tools.description: Plan a single checkbox-state edit selected by root block index or nested block path

tools.name: plan_markdown_structure
tools.description: Plan a typed structural Markdown operation: section insert/remove/move/rename, list move/renumber, table row/column move, or reference add/relabel/remove/unlink

tools.name: decode_json
tools.description: Recover schema-valid JSON with effort bounds, ambiguity, and inference receipts

tools.name: recover_tool_calls
tools.description: Recover the tool calls of one model turn against caller tool declarations (OpenAI, MCP, or Anthropic form) over built-in call dialects, with per-call outcomes, itemized repairs and losses, rejected attempts (including call markup of dialects not built in or not allowed, reported as unsupported_dialect), the tool-choice check, the turn's finish, optional re-emission, and a receipt; never executes a call

output.description: Model output text of one turn; the CLI recover-tool-calls command accepts the same output as raw bytes, recording invalid UTF-8 as a loss

tools.description: Tool declarations in tools_format: the declarations value, or a string holding the raw declaration JSON, which is read byte for byte (render-back and schema digests then refer to exactly those bytes; a structured value is written back compactly, keeping member order and number spellings)

ids.description: Call ids. Default (omitted): keep each id the model wrote, and number every other call call_<12 hex digits of the output's SHA-256>_<index>, so different turns never share ids without caller state; a missing or repeated model id is numbered and recorded as a tool_call.id.dedup inference. "source": the output's ids, deduplicated as <id>#<index>. {"prefix", "start"}: number every call prefix+(start+index) (prefix defaults to call_, start to 0); pass the result's next_id_start as the next round's start

tools.name: validate_json
tools.description: Validate a JSON instance against a schema, reporting violations, always-evaluated format/pattern evidence, and unsupported-vocabulary evidence

tools.name: generate_json_witness
tools.description: Generate a witness instance for a JSON Schema location, prove unsatisfiability with refutation evidence, or report explicit search exhaustion; never claims unsatisfiability from a governor hard stop

tools.name: match_strings
tools.description: Rank caller-identified strings and aliases using exact, Unicode, lexical, distance, and optional English phonetic evidence

tools.name: resolve_string
tools.description: Select a caller-identified string with explicit exact, guess, ambiguity, and weak-match outcomes

tools.name: match_paths
tools.description: Resolve caller-supplied relative paths with context, explicit ambiguity, and guess receipts; never opens or authorizes a matched path

tools.name: resolve_intent
tools.description: Resolve explicit semantic domain rules against caller concepts; unknown words fail, conflicting interpretations remain ambiguous, and no model is contacted

tools.name: plan_replacement
tools.description: Plan exact or bounded fuzzy text replacement; approximate selections remain guesses and ties remain ambiguous

tools.name: plan_diff
tools.description: Plan a single-file unified diff with relocatable exact context and source-bound edit ranges

tools.name: inspect_code
tools.description: Inspect grammar acceptance, source-bound declaration ranges, JSX rename repair options, and parse allocator accounting without executing code

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a bounded root-relative UTF-8 file and its exact digest

tools.name: apply_edit
tools.description: Apply one caller-selected source-bound edit plan to a buffer, optionally validate code syntax, optionally rebase a stale plan onto an intervening change, and return text, exact inverse, and a receipt; no file writes

tools.name: apply_file
tools.description: Conditionally apply one selected edit plan or a replacement buffer, optionally rebase a stale plan onto an intervening change, validate supported code grammar, journal it, and return undo identity

tools.name: undo_file
tools.description: Undo a journaled file replacement only if its exact output is still present

tools.name: recover_files
tools.description: Reconcile prepared journals without overwriting targets; remove only bounded compatible temporary bytes beside a validated journal's recorded target, preserving uncertain artifacts with reasons

tools.name: commit_files
tools.description: Independently journal and commit each of several file replacements, never as one atomic multi-file transaction

tools.name: prepare_helper
tools.description: Prepare a non-streaming completion request for a caller-selected provider/model/schema/input, performing no network I/O; the caller's own transport sends the returned request

tools.name: complete_helper
tools.description: Resume a prepared helper request with its caller-observed HTTP status and body, returning a recovered outcome with a receipt; refusals and non-completed responses remain unsuccessful
